candidate.description: Preserve the retained exact QK, producer maximum, compiler expf, ordered F32 denominator, gate, and ownership, but replace each output dimension's 512 scalar F32 PV FMAs with one serial FP64 FMA chain and round once before the existing divide/gate/BF16 boundary.
candidate.premise: Test whether intrinsically higher-precision PV association can provide a numerically admissible bridge toward llama.cpp Vulkan's cooperative-matrix PV without output-derived repair.

correctness.red: The focused wrapped/evicted oracle failed before implementation because the FP64-PV wrapper did not exist.
correctness.positions: 512-519 after ring wrap plus explicit position-200 eviction

decision.reason: Serial FP64 PV is 2.81x the retained leaf and still does not reproduce the BF16 recurrent boundary. It fails before trace, model-quality, or runtime integration.
decision.finding: Greater mathematical accumulation precision is not equivalent to the retained scalar-F32 association. A future cooperative path must carry a validated high-precision algorithm and error bound; FP64 substitution is not that bridge.
